breakdown.description: The prompt computes reduction of area from a diameter ratio instead of from the initial and final cross-sectional areas.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes percent reduction of area using the initial and final cross-sectional areas (A0 and Af), not from a simple diameter ratio. It explicitly calculates A0 = π(6)² and Af = π(4.8)², then applies %RA = 100(A0 - Af)/A0, which matches the ground truth approach.

breakdown.description: The prompt uses the final gage length in the denominator for percent elongation, whereas percent elongation is referenced to the original gage length.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the original gage length L0 = 50 mm in the denominator for percent elongation: %EL = 100(Lf - L0)/L0 = 100(66 - 50)/50 = 32%. This matches the ground truth formula and avoids the incorrect use of Lf in the denominator.
